text:
maria: Heads-up — Night ops deploy tonight 02:00 UTC. Need a short FF ramp plan for `session-sticky-unwind` (we're unpinning sticky routing for model-routing v3).

akash: ack. plan I propose: cohort 0: 5% (canary eu-west) -> 20% after 15m soak -> 100% after 60m if signals clean. Manual holdpoints at each step.

leo: +1. Add SLO guards: if error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency > 800ms for 10m -> trigger rollback and pin back to v3.1.9. Also tie to deploybot drain script.

sana: will run the smoke prompt set and a short regen eval at 5% and 20% to watch quality drift. I have a baseline eval saved under /evals/2026-03-session-sticky.json.

akash: tagging @deploy-bot for scheduling and pinning instructions. Also note release notes: brief bullet list for product: - unpin sticky routing for model v3 (reduces tail queueing) - 5% -> 20% -> 100% ramp with manual holds - rollback criteria and contact list.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: version=v3.2.0, target=canary(eu-west-1), ff=session-sticky-unwind=5%.

deploy-bot: Action commands (ops):
```
# to advance cohort
/deploy advance-cohort session-sticky-unwind
# to rollback and re-pin
/deploy rollback --version=v3.1.9 --re-pin
# to abort
/deploy abort
```

maria: note for oncall: if you see session-affinity drop > 10% on canary, pause and @leo. We'll keep a short quiet window 02:00-04:00 UTC.

leo: I'll enable surgeguard and a temporary rate cap on model-routing to avoid cascade. Also adding a brief A/B trace tag to requests to track client affinity.

akash: Release notes (for changelog):
- Performance: reduced median routing latency for long sessions by ~25% on canary (measured in lab).
- Risk: possible transient affinity mismatch for websocket clients; mitigation = temporary reassign and sticky-cookie re-issue.
- Rollback plan: pin to v3.1.9 and drain v3.2.0 instances; contact list: maria, akash, leo, sana.

sana: I'll post quick QA checklist under #help if anything flaps during ramp.

maria: OK let's proceed with this plan. Akash, kick the canary at 02:00 and don't advance without an ack from leo/sana. :thumbsup:

akash: Roger. I will start the canary now and ping here when it's live.

deploy-bot: Canary live @1775000028 — session-sticky-unwind=5% on eu-west-1. Keep threads here for decisioning. :robot_face:
